Industries

RF assemblies installed
all around the world.

We offer a wide range of RF cable and connector assemblies, including RG, micro coax, semi-flex and other special custom-made cables and connectors.

Our approach

Wired for what’s next.

The full assembled telecommunication applications are manufactured in ARNIR with stringent quality control measures to ensure that every product we produce meets the highest standards of performance and durability.

We specialize in high-reliability communication and RF harness assemblies designed to preserve signal integrity under the absolute toughest conditions.

Every single RF and communication harness coming off our production floor undergoes rigorous verification, including 100% Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) testing.

Built to IPC/WHMA-A-620 Class 3 and aerospace-grade certifications, we deliver complete test reports with every serialized harness, giving your integration team absolute confidence on the assembly line.

What we build

Micro‑coax and semi‑flex assemblies.

  • RF cable assemblies – RG, micro coax and semi-flex
  • Special custom-made cables and connectors
  • RF connectors
  • PCB assembly (PCBA) for telecommunication applications
  • Full assembly of finished telecommunication applications
